subject: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC) - next steps
messages:
From: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@globexretail.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Bergstrom <jonas.bergstrom@globexretail.se>
Date: 2027-06-12T14:15:00+02:00
Subject: Quick recap + follow-ups from our call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier - really helpful. A quick recap from our side and a few requests so we can evaluate fit across our EU/APAC catalogs: 

- Scope: product descriptions, customer support replies, and localized marketing copy across 8 EU languages (EN, FR, DE, NL, PL, CS, ES, IT) and 3 APAC languages (JA, KO, ZH).
- Immediate asks: recommended model(s) for balance of latency/cost/quality, any benchmark results you can share for these locales, and an initial prompt set we can run locally.
- Concern: we had quality regressions when switching quantized weights on our self-hosted stack last quarter - want to make sure we have regression checks for low-resource EU languages (PL, CS) and JA.

Can you send a summary with next steps and any artifacts we can use for our eval? We'd like to get a pilot scheduled for July.

Best,
Anna

--
Anna Müller
Head of AI Platforms
Globex Retail
anna.mueller@globexretail.de
+49 30 555 0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@globexretail.de>
Cc: Jonas Bergstrom <jonas.bergstrom@globexretail.se>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T16:02:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + follow-ups from our call

Hi Anna - great meeting, thanks for the clear scope. Recap + next steps below.

Short recommendation summary:
- Recommended models: 1) redwood-rlhf-13b for a strong cost/latency tradeoff on multilingual copy and support tasks; 2) redwood-llm-32b-int8 (quantized) for highest-quality localized copy where you can tolerate slightly higher latency.
- Why: 13B variant maintains good core-language understanding across EU languages and is optimized with our locale-aware tokenization. 32B-int8 gives the best fluency in JA/KO and high-resource EU languages.

Artifacts I attached for initial eval: 
- prompt_set_globex.csv (a seed of 120 prompts across the 11 target locales; includes desired outputs + scoring rubric)
- redwood_benchmarks_eu_apac.pdf (summary of our internal benchmarks vs open models across the locales you mentioned)

Immediate next steps / proposed plan:
1) You drop a small labeled sample (5-10 examples per language) so we can run targeted quality regression checks (we can run our evals and share delta plots).
2) Rishi (cc) will propose an eval job config (batch size, temperature sweep, metrics) and an S3/Drive ingestion template.
3) We run a 2-week pilot: 2 models (13B, 32B-int8) on your sample set + our standard eval harness.
4) Post-pilot: decision matrix with cost/latency/quality tradeoffs and rollout recommendations (cache + prefix strategies to reduce token cost).

Known risk/mitigation: quantized regressions are rare but noticeable in PL/CS/JA for copy generation. Mitigation: we recommend A/Bing quantized vs non-quantized on a per-route basis and adding locale-specific eval triggers that fail the deployment if top-line quality drops >4 points on your rubric.

Files attached: prompt_set_globex.csv, redwood_benchmarks_eu_apac.pdf

Links:
- Pilot eval workspace: https://app.redwood-inference.com/evals/GLOBEX-003
- Shared Drive with prompt set and sample templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGlobexEval

Proposed timeline:
- We draft eval config: by 2027-06-14
- You share sample labels: by 2027-06-18
- Pilot run: 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-14

If that works I'd ask Rishi to send the eval-config and schedule a 30-min sync to finalize ingestion.

Thanks -
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0198
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@globexretail.de>, Jonas Bergstrom <jonas.bergstrom@globexretail.se>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: FW: Quick recap + follow-ups from our call

Marissa / Neha - quick note outlining the eval config I propose for Globex. Keeping it tight to reduce pilot cost but catch regressions: 

- Dataset: 10 labeled examples per language (11 locales) -> 110 rows. Use the attached prompt_set_globex.csv as the template.
- Metrics: BLEU, chrF, ROUGE-L, semantic-similarity (embedding cosine) + our human-assigned adequacy score (1-5).
- Runs: redwood-rlhf-13b @ temp [0.0, 0.2, 0.7] and redwood-llm-32b-int8 @ temp [0.0, 0.2].
- Quantization check: for PL/CS/JA run both quantized and fp16 for a 20-sample subset to measure delta.
- Eval infra: ingestion to S3 + kick off Redwood eval job -> outputs to Drive / dashboard linked above.

Action items for us:
- Marissa: confirm pilot windows and customer timezones for kickoff.
- Neha: coordinate CS for sample ingestion template and to confirm acceptance criteria for go/no-go post-pilot.

I'd also recommend enabling the locale-failure alert (any locale drops >4 points on adequacy) so we can auto-failroll to the 13B model if the 32B-int8 shows regressions.

- Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@globexretail.de>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + follow-ups from our call

Thanks all, this looks great and aligns with our internal expectations. A couple quick points: 

- We can provide the 10 labeled examples per language by 2027-06-17; I'll upload to the Drive folder you linked.
- For the quantization checks: please prioritize PL and JA (we're seeing the largest variance there historically).
- Timeline: July pilot window works. Can we schedule kickoff on 2027-07-01 at 09:00 CEST for the initial sync?

I'd also like the idea of an automated locale failure alert. Please include sample alert wording in the kickoff so our Ops team can approve it ahead of time.

Attached: sample_manifest.csv (contains mapping of language codes to product SKUs).

Best,
Anna
